lastCallNote: This is the final law. Every law above it is still in force. The next slip-up closes the session.

laws.d: Nobody may say drink, drank, drunk or shot. Point at your glass like an adult.
Everyone gets addressed by a nickname, a title, or an elaborate description. Real names are contraband.
Address them by the full title, every single time. "Hey" is not a title.
Left-handers included. Every sip, for the rest of the session.
Elbows, chins and feet only. Indicate things with dignity.
Name someone at the table and say why, before the glass reaches your lips. No reason may be used twice.
You may fish, imply and insinuate. You may not simply ask.

laws.t: Phones face down on the table.
laws.d: Lifting one for any reason that isn't this game is a violation.

laws.t: Nobody may cross their arms or legs.
laws.d: Open posture, all session. {maker} rules on borderline cases.
Not one. The bar is lower than you think, and so are you.

laws.t: Speak only in the third person.
laws.d: "She would like another one." Every sentence, all session.
{maker} names one player now. Nobody may pour their own — only the Cup Bearer pours, and they drink if they refuse.
Every single one. Allegedly.
Fully upright, then sit back down. Every time.
Find another way. Nodding now counts as speech.

laws.t: Hands on the table whenever anyone laughs.
laws.d: Last hand down drinks. This will happen far more than you expect.
{maker} picks one right now. Everybody speaks in it until further notice.
Before you speak, compliment whoever spoke last. Specific, and never repeated.

laws.t: The glass may not touch the table.
laws.d: Hold it, balance it, or hand it to someone. The table is lava.
Or refer to the laws as laws, or the session as a game. Improvise.
Foreheads, chins, ceilings. Any two people caught meeting eyes — both drink.
{maker} reassigns every player someone else's name, right now. You are that person and you answer to it.
The self is cancelled.

laws.t: The full book is read before every new law.
laws.d: Out loud, in order, by whoever is about to make the next one. Miss a law, drink.
Whatever The Judge does with their hands, the table copies. They will abuse this immediately.
Toasted at, you toast back — and neither of you may reuse a reason from tonight.
Any question put to you gets an honest answer. You may buy out twice, ever, by drinking.
At anything. Good luck.
Any player may call "loudest" once per law. The table votes, and the loudest voice drinks.
Every law above this one now costs double. Nothing has been repealed. Nothing ever is.
